paras.text: Real time operating systems are those operating systems which give quick response to users requests without delaying them. Unlike batch processing operating systems, real time operating systems produce immediate response to users requests as they are input to the system. The success rate of these operating systems is not only measured in terms of the correctness of the logically computed result, but also on the basis of time at which the results are produced. As these systems process the users input immediately, therefore, the systems supports high degree of interactivity and as a result they can be widely used in critical environments, such as, air traffic control systems, radar system, missiles systems etc.

Hard-real time operating system guarantees the solution in the specified time constraint; otherwise, the results are catastrophic such as flight navigation, automobile, and spacecraft systems. sections.theory:
e. Real-Time operating system

Real time operating systems are those operating systems which give quick response to users requests without delaying them. Unlike batch processing operating systems, real time operating systems produce immediate response to users requests as they are input to the system. The success rate of these operating systems is not only measured in terms of the correctness of the logically computed result, but also on the basis of time at which the results are produced. As these systems process the users input immediately, therefore, the systems supports high degree of interactivity and as a result they can be widely used in critical environments, such as, air traffic control systems, radar system, missiles systems etc.

As the results of real time operating systems are time-based, therefore, they are grouped into hard-real time operating systems and soft-real time operating systems. Hard-real time operating system guarantees the solution in the specified time constraint; otherwise, the results are catastrophic such as flight navigation, automobile, and spacecraft systems. In soft-real time operating systems, if the deadlines are missed by some amount of time still they are acceptable such as media streaming in distributed systems.

Features of real time operating system

A real time operating system guarantees a solution or results within a specific time.

These are multitasking operating systems.

These operating systems are used for the execution of real-time applications, such as weather forecasting, geographical information retrieval, controlling machinery, scientific instruments and industrial systems etc.

These systems are aimed on quick and predictable response to events.

When these systems start execution of a task, they do not provide full control to the users to interact or interfere in that processing.

f. Multiprocessor operating system

The use of two or more central processing units (CPUs) within a single computer system is called Multiprocessing. A multiprocessing system can run multiple tasks in parallel on multiple CPU’s and thus there should be an operating system to control such parallel executions. Multiprocessor operating systems are the operating systems that perform this task.

As multiprocessing operating systems execute multiple tasks in parallel, therefore, a single process can be divided into small independent units, called threads, and executed in parallel on multiple processors giving birth to the concept of multithreading.

The most commonly used multiprocessing systems are symmetric multiprocessing and asymmetric multiprocessing. In symmetric multiprocessing systems, all the CPUs are equal but in asymmetric multiprocessing systems there is one master CPU controlling other CPUs called slave CPUs.

Advantages of multiprocessing operating systems

If you have to run multiple programs at the same time, multi-processors can be very useful. Another advantage of multi-processors is that more and more programs these days are multithreaded. A multi-threaded application is a single program or application that can make use of more than one processors/cores. If one processor fails to work then the load is shared by other processors.

Limitations of multiprocessing operating system

Cost and power consumptions are the disadvantages of multiprocessing operating systems. A large main memory is required. A very sophisticated operating system is required to schedule, balance and co-ordinate the input, output and processing activities of multiple CPUs.

څرنګه چې د سمدستي عملیاتي سیسټمونو پایلې پر وخت ولاړې دي، نو په سختو سمدستي او نرمو سمدستي عملیاتي سیسټمونو وېشل کېږي. سخت سمدستي عملیاتي سیسټم په ټاکلي وخت کې د حل تضمین کوي؛ که نه پایلې ویجاړونکې وي، لکه د الوتنې لارښوونه، موټر او فضايي بېړۍ سیسټمونه. په نرمو سمدستي عملیاتي سیسټمونو کې که ټاکلې نېټه یو څه وخت تېره شي، بیا هم د منلو وړ وي، لکه په وېشل شویو سیسټمونو کې د رسنیو بهیر (media streaming).

سمدستي عملیاتي سیسټم په یوه ټاکلي وخت کې د حل یا پایلو تضمین کوي.

دا عملیاتي سیسټمونه د سمدستي کاريالونو د اجرا لپاره کارول کېږي، لکه د هوا وړاندوینه، د جغرافیايي معلوماتو را اخیستل، د ماشینرۍ کنټرول، ساینسي وسایل او صنعتي سیسټمونه او نور.

څرنګه چې د سمدستي عملیاتي سیسټمونو پایلې پر وخت ولاړې دي، نو په سختو سمدستي او نرمو سمدستي عملیاتي سیسټمونو وېشل کېږي. سخت سمدستي عملیاتي سیسټم په ټاکلي وخت کې د حل تضمین کوي؛ که نه پایلې ویجاړونکې وي، لکه د الوتنې لارښوونه، موټر او فضايي بېړۍ سیسټمونه. په نرمو سمدستي عملیاتي سیسټمونو کې که ټاکلې نېټه یو څه وخت تېره شي، بیا هم د منلو وړ وي، لکه په وېشل شویو سیسټمونو کې د رسنیو بهیر (media streaming).

د سمدستي عملیاتي سیسټم ځانګړنې

سمدستي عملیاتي سیسټم په یوه ټاکلي وخت کې د حل یا پایلو تضمین کوي.

دا څو-دندیز عملیاتي سیسټمونه دي.

دا عملیاتي سیسټمونه د سمدستي کاريالونو د اجرا لپاره کارول کېږي، لکه د هوا وړاندوینه، د جغرافیايي معلوماتو را اخیستل، د ماشینرۍ کنټرول، ساینسي وسایل او صنعتي سیسټمونه او نور.

د دې سیسټمونو موخه پېښو ته چټک او د وړاندوینې وړ ځواب دی.

کله چې دا سیسټمونه د یوې دندې اجرا پیل کړي، کاروونکو ته په هغه پروسس کې د تعامل یا مداخلې بشپړ کنټرول نه ورکوي.

f. څو-پروسېسوري عملیاتي سیسټم

په یوه کمپیوټري سیسټم کې د دوو یا ډېرو مرکزي پروسس واحدونو (CPUs) کارونې ته څو-پروسسي کار ویل کېږي. څو-پروسسي سیسټم پر ډېرو CPUs ډېرې دندې په موازي ډول چلولی شي، نو باید داسې عملیاتي سیسټم وي چې دا موازي اجرا کنټرول کړي. څو-پروسېسوري عملیاتي سیسټمونه هغه دي چې دا دنده ترسره کوي.

څرنګه چې څو-پروسسي عملیاتي سیسټمونه ډېرې دندې په موازي ډول اجرا کوي، نو یوه پروسه په کوچنیو خپلواکو واحدونو وېشل کېدای شي چې تارونه (threads) بلل کېږي، او پر ډېرو پروسېسرونو په موازي ډول اجرا کېدای شي، چې له دې د څو-تاریز کار (multithreading) مفهوم زېږي.

تر ټولو ډېر کارېدونکي څو-پروسسي سیسټمونه متناظر (symmetric) او نامتناظر (asymmetric) څو-پروسسي کار دي. په متناظرو سیسټمونو کې ټول CPUs برابر وي، خو په نامتناظرو سیسټمونو کې یو مشر (master) CPU وي چې نور CPUs کنټرولوي، چې تابع (slave) CPUs بلل کېږي.

د څو-پروسسي عملیاتي سیسټمونو ګټې

که تاسو په یو وخت ډېر پروګرامونه چلول غواړئ، څو-پروسېسرونه ډېر ګټور کېدای شي. د څو-پروسېسرونو بله ګټه دا ده چې نن ورځ ډېر او لا ډېر پروګرامونه څو-تاریز دي. څو-تاریز کاريال یو داسې پروګرام یا کاريال دی چې له یوه زیات پروسېسرونو/زړو (cores) ګټه اخیستی شي. که یو پروسېسر کار پرېږدي، بار نور پروسېسرونه شریکوي.

د څو-پروسسي عملیاتي سیسټم محدودیتونه

لګښت او د برېښنا مصرف د څو-پروسسي عملیاتي سیسټمونو زیانونه دي. لویه اصلي حافظه اړینه ده. د ډېرو CPUs د ننوتو، وتو او پروسس فعالیتونو د مهالوېش، توازن او همغږۍ لپاره ډېر پرمختللي عملیاتي سیسټم ته اړتیا ده.

e. Real-Time operating system

Real time operating systems are those operating systems which give quick response to users requests without delaying them. Unlike batch processing operating systems, real time operating systems produce immediate response to users requests as they are input to the system. The success rate of these operating systems is not only measured in terms of the correctness of the logically computed result, but also on the basis of time at which the results are produced. As these systems process the users input immediately, therefore, the systems supports high degree of interactivity and as a result they can be widely used in critical environments, such as, air traffic control systems, radar system, missiles systems etc.

As the results of real time operating systems are time-based, therefore, they are grouped into hard-real time operating systems and soft-real time operating systems. Hard-real time operating system guarantees the solution in the specified time constraint; otherwise, the results are catastrophic such as flight navigation, automobile, and spacecraft systems. In soft-real time operating systems, if the deadlines are missed by some amount of time still they are acceptable such as media streaming in distributed systems.

Features of real time operating system

A real time operating system guarantees a solution or results within a specific time.

These are multitasking operating systems.

These operating systems are used for the execution of real-time applications, such as weather forecasting, geographical information retrieval, controlling machinery, scientific instruments and industrial systems etc.

These systems are aimed on quick and predictable response to events.

When these systems start execution of a task, they do not provide full control to the users to interact or interfere in that processing.

f. Multiprocessor operating system

The use of two or more central processing units (CPUs) within a single computer system is called Multiprocessing. A multiprocessing system can run multiple tasks in parallel on multiple CPU’s and thus there should be an operating system to control such parallel executions. Multiprocessor operating systems are the operating systems that perform this task.

As multiprocessing operating systems execute multiple tasks in parallel, therefore, a single process can be divided into small independent units, called threads, and executed in parallel on multiple processors giving birth to the concept of multithreading.

The most commonly used multiprocessing systems are symmetric multiprocessing and asymmetric multiprocessing. In symmetric multiprocessing systems, all the CPUs are equal but in asymmetric multiprocessing systems there is one master CPU controlling other CPUs called slave CPUs.

Advantages of multiprocessing operating systems

If you have to run multiple programs at the same time, multi-processors can be very useful. Another advantage of multi-processors is that more and more programs these days are multithreaded. A multi-threaded application is a single program or application that can make use of more than one processors/cores. If one processor fails to work then the load is shared by other processors.

Limitations of multiprocessing operating system

Cost and power consumptions are the disadvantages of multiprocessing operating systems. A large main memory is required. A very sophisticated operating system is required to schedule, balance and co-ordinate the input, output and processing activities of multiple CPUs.
